clips.title: The story
paras: Manor Mistmantle is a decaying estate nestled in the shadowed hills of northeastern Duskwood, north of Darkshire. Once a proper family homestead, it has fallen into ruin and horror, crawling with undead ghouls bound to its infamous master.

Located west of Beggar's Haunt, Manor Mistmantle stands as a grim monument to murder and madness. The grounds are choked with decay and prowled by vicious ghouls who defend the ruined structure. Amidst the rot and withered vegetation, the only sign of living beauty on the entire property is a solitary, sorrowful blossom growing in the untended garden: the flower known as the Tear of Tilloa.
